summary.headline: Casanatense Codex 1386
summary.text: Description of Casanatense Codex 1386, comprising nine manuscript fragments and a codicil, including fifteenth-century paper folios with an anonymous commentary on Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos and its subscription.
